description: Canonical machine-readable registry of Identity Agent action codes. Integer `code` (t) is the canonical wire identifier; `key` is the stable human/URL handle (used as ?action= in OOBI URLs and as the share_actions.action_key). This file is the single source of truth: it seeds identity.db and is imported by any Identity Agent. See docs/action-code-registry.md for the spec + governance.

actions.name: Sign in
actions.summary: Authenticate to a relying party (website/app/device) with a pairwise identity.
actions.outcome: The agent presents a pairwise AID (per-RP by default; anchored to a chosen identity when relationship_anchor_aid is set), signs the challenge, and the RP verifies and optionally applies its access policy.

actions.name: Add Contact
actions.summary: A mutual, front-facing "we know each other" contact ceremony between two agents.
actions.outcome: Each side records the other as a contact at the chosen tier (distinct from low-level transactional KERI contacts, which are automatic and unceremonious).

actions.name: Add Employee
actions.summary: An organization invites an individual to become an employee; the individual's agent presents a stable per-org pairwise identity to be enrolled.
actions.outcome: The individual derives/reuses a stable pairwise AID for the org and is added to the counterpart's roster (pending -> active on approval). The code + schema are universal; the roster/approval mechanics are an implementation concern.

actions.name: Sponsor Organization
actions.summary: An individual attests (vouches) that a real person stands behind a newly created organization, becoming its founding super-admin.

preview_contract.title: Sponsor {org} — become its super-admin and first employee.

actions.outcome: The individual signs a vouch over the organization's AID (stored by the counterpart as proof) and is enrolled as the active super-admin. No delegated inception — the organization controls its own keys; the sponsor only attests.
